meta.title: Los Verdiales — Marbella
meta.description: Los Verdiales — a private residence in Marbella shaped by Mediterranean light and natural materials.

hero.tagline: A private residence shaped by Mediterranean light, natural materials and a quieter idea of luxury.
hero.headline: Splendour of *Stillness*

sections.title: A home designed to be felt before it is understood.
sections.lead: Los Verdiales is conceived as a complete private world — architecture, interiors and landscape moving as one.

sections.subtitle: Essence of Self-Care
sections.title: Wellness
sections.intro: Pool, training and relaxation spaces form a secluded wellness world at the heart of the residence. Time slows down here.

amenities.label: Pool
amenities.text: A sheltered pool terrace where water, light and stone meet — designed for unhurried mornings and long Mediterranean evenings.

amenities.label: Training
amenities.text: A dedicated training space with natural ventilation and views towards the garden — fitness without leaving the privacy of home.

amenities.label: Spa
amenities.text: Stone, restrained cabinetry and aged metal details give the spa rooms a residential warmth rather than a conventional hotel feel.

amenities.label: Relax
amenities.text: Layered textiles, deep timber tones and softly illuminated surfaces create a private atmosphere removed from the more social spaces of the house.

sections.subtitle: Lightness of Being
sections.title: Mediterranean Light
paragraphs: Filtered daylight moves through the house all day — across stone floors, warm timber and bronze details.
Los Verdiales is deeply connected to Marbella: the climate, the landscape, and a slower rhythm of life.
sections.pullquote: Life opens towards the light. The main living spaces are deliberately calm.

sections.subtitle: Essence of Place
sections.title: Marbella
sections.intro: Set on the Costa del Sol, Los Verdiales offers the privacy of a standalone residence within reach of Marbella's finest coast, dining and culture.
sections.pullquote: Private from the very first moment. A restrained palette and carefully considered proportions establish the character of the residence before the details reveal themselves.

sections.subtitle: Inspired Materiality
sections.title: Stone. Oak. Bronze. Linen.
paragraphs: Every material chosen to become more beautiful with time. Natural stone, warm timber, bronze details and filtered daylight create a house that feels settled, tactile and deeply connected to its setting.
Bespoke joinery, subtle texture and warm lighting bring intimacy to the scale of the house.

sections.subtitle: The Residence
sections.title: A Complete Private World
sections.intro: One exceptional private residence — architecture, interiors and landscape conceived as a single, coherent experience.

feature.title: Primary Suite
feature.text: A retreat within the residence. Layered textiles, deep timber tones and softly illuminated surfaces create a private atmosphere removed from the more social spaces of the house.

sections.subtitle: Beauty in the Essence of Things
sections.title: Interiors
sections.intro: Our designs are chosen with a delicate treatment of materials and time — natural stone, warm wood, aged metal, and textured textiles.

gallery.title: Light, proportion and a softer rhythm.

contact.title: By appointment only.
contact.text: For specifications, plans, availability and a private viewing of Los Verdiales, request the full presentation.
